emptyWorldLifecycle.scope: Chrome headless, DPR 1; one document without reload, six normal UI save/new-world/load cycles. Only read-only window.voxel.snapshot/exportSave/project observation. Renderer must remain Worker WebGL2. Render geometry/texture counts are live Three.js resources; terrainGeometryBytes counts tracked terrain buffers, not total GPU memory. CDP Performance JSHeapUsedSize/JSHeapTotalSize covers the main page isolate only, excluding simulation/render workers, native browser allocations and VRAM. This bounded lifecycle run is not a long-duration leak proof or universal capacity estimate.
